github_branch_protection.note: Before production GO, attach evidence that the canonical integration/main branch policy is protected with the required PR/check/force-push controls. Current issue #91 remains the tracking gate until verified.

drive_launch_control_permissions.note: Before production GO, attach Drive permission metadata proving that anyone-with-link writer access has been removed from all 13 top-level Three Crowns project folders and current launch-control Docs/Sheets, with named-editor/read-only policy in place. Current issue #100 remains the tracking gate until verified.

room_reconciliation.note: Physical room import gate #38 is closed. On the real external staging database, run the approved importer dry-run, review the diff against the canonical 84-room register, then record safe reconciliation evidence.

beget_host_preflight.note: Run non-destructive host preflight on the actual target host/account.

legacy_rollback_backup.note: Require archive/dump/config/DNS evidence and checksum for the currently live site.

external_https_wss_staging.note: Real external staging must prove HTTPS, WSS, cookies, CORS, persistence and private PostgreSQL.

external_public_truth_probe.note: Run external_public_truth_probe.py against the real staging URL.

real_device_acceptance.note: Require iPhone, Android, desktop and Telegram/staff acceptance on real devices.

provider_acceptance.note: If WhatsApp/API Green/ManyChat or another provider is launch-enabled, change enabled=true and attach VERIFIED provider E2E evidence.

monitoring_alerting.note: Require real health/readiness, 5xx, container, DB/storage and backup-failure visibility.

pre_cutover_backup.note: Fresh backup immediately before cutover with timestamp/checksum/restore owner.

dns_rollback_capture.note: Capture current DNS and exact rollback target before any switch.

owner_cutover_approval.note: Final production/DNS switch requires explicit owner approval after all other gates are complete.
